name: Shubham Kumar
title: Senior Data Scientist
executive_summary: Shubham Kumar demonstrates strong AI readiness as a Senior Data Scientist with over four years of experience in Fintech and Healthcare AI applications. His profile shows deep technical fluency in Generative AI, NLP, OCR, and LLM-based automation, with measurable business impact such as 95% coding accuracy in healthcare automation and large-scale invoice processing in Fintech. His strongest edge lies in end-to-end model deployment and cross-domain adaptability. The biggest risk is limited exposure to AI governance, compliance frameworks, and strategic leadership beyond technical execution. To advance toward AI leadership roles, Shubham should focus on developing governance literacy, stakeholder communication, and productization strategy skills. Strengthening his visibility in responsible AI and scaling frameworks will position him for senior technical leadership or AI product management roles within the next 12–18 months.
